}}'''Latian Basar''' is a young [[Cairhien]]in nobleman and a member of [[Cha Faile]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Latian Basar}}

== Appearance ==
He is pale with a sharp nose.

== Activities ==
He accompanies [[Faile Bashere]] to [[Ghealdan]].

He accompanies [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Sebban Balwer]], who has taken ''Cha Faile'' under his wing, into [[So Habor]]. They find [[Martyn Tallanvor]] there and bring him back to Perrin.
